question: For each integer $i,\ 1\le i\le100$, let $c_i$ be either $+1$ or $-1$. Assume that $c_1=+1$ and $c_1+\cdots+c_i>0$ for all $i\ge2$. If $c_i=-1$, then $c_{i-1}=+1$. One of the following statements about the total number of sign changes is correct.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
